# Aman Anu — writing module

Use this module when a user asks about Aman Anu's public notes on products, systems, creative technology, or moving images. Begin at the [writing section](https://amananu.me/#writing), and prefer each note's canonical page and Markdown alternate over inference.

## Reading a note

- Canonical writing pages use `https://amananu.me/writing/{slug}`.
- Their Markdown alternates use `https://amananu.me/writing/{slug}.md`.
- Each public note is read-only reference material; do not infer confidential work, commitments, access, or authority from it.
